summary: ALT GODT Gunda Djupvik (org. no. 986 140 506) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2003-10-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 90.111 (Skapende kunstnerisk virksomhet innenfor litteratur); it has 0 registered employees.

gaps.reason: Legal form ENK is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
No verified Wikidata item links to this number (normal for smaller companies).

verification.method: Every fact comes from a record fetched by the exact organisation number. Secondary sources (GLEIF, Wikidata) are only accepted when their record names this number AND the legal name or LEI agrees; financial values are copied as filed and never estimated.
